engine.win_condition: Generate energy counters by casting artifacts with Dr. Madison Li, then convert energy into card advantage, artifact recursion, and board buffs. Win through artifact-based combat damage or the Mechanized Production combo.

Mill cards via rad counters and dedicated mill effects, triggering The Wise Mothman to place +1/+1 counters on creatures based on cards milled. Proliferate and counter-doubling effects amplify growth, creating an overwhelming attacking force.

Generate tokens through Caesar's sacrifice trigger and token generators like Assemble the Legion, then drain opponents through aristocrats payoffs (Bastion of Remembrance, Pitiless Plunderer). Caesar's third mode deals direct damage based on token count as an alternate finisher.

Generate energy through casting artifacts and artificers, use Saheeli's ability to create hasty token copies of powerful permanents, and win through combat damage. Lightning Runner provides an infinite combat combo line when combined with energy generation.

Fill the graveyard through self-mill and sacrifice to achieve delirium, then use Winter's end-step ability to repeatedly reanimate high-impact permanents like Hornet Queen and Grist. Wins through overwhelming recursive value.

Trigger landfall repeatedly to manifest creatures face-down via Zimone, then flip high-value permanents. Generate overwhelming board presence through Scute Swarm tokens and landfall payoffs like Tatyova and Aesi, winning through combat damage.

Generate artifact tokens (Food and Clues) by casting historic spells through the commanders' abilities, leverage legendary and artifact synergies via Heroes' Podium and Day of Destiny, and win through accumulated card advantage and board presence.

Attack repeatedly to trigger The Tenth Doctor's exile-and-suspend ability while Rose Tyler grows larger with time counters from each attack. Win through combat damage with an increasingly massive Rose Tyler backed by value from suspended cards resolving.

Cast spells from graveyard and exile to trigger The Thirteenth Doctor's Paradox ability, accumulating +1/+1 counters on creatures and untapping them at end step for repeated value, then win through sustained combat damage.

Accumulate +1/+1 counters through Tidus's counter-moving and proliferate triggers from Inexorable Tide and Grateful Apparition, then win via Walking Ballista direct damage or overwhelming board presence. The Ballista + Hardened Scales combo provides an instant-win alternate line.

Power up Cloud and other creatures with Equipment, drawing cards from Cloud's attack trigger when equipped creatures attack. Win through commander damage or overwhelming combat damage, with Treasure generation when Cloud reaches power 7+.

Mill creatures into the graveyard via Terra's combat trigger and other mill effects, then reanimate high-value creatures like Sepulchral Primordial, Sun Titan, and Flayer of the Hatebound. Win through accumulated value and combat damage from reanimated threats, with Flayer providing direct damage when creatures enter from the graveyard.

Cast high-mana-value noncreature spells to repeatedly trigger Y'shtola's 2-damage burn ability, draining opponents while gaining life and drawing cards from the life-loss triggers to sustain the engine.

Accumulate +1/+1 and charge counters on artifacts via Inspirit, Steel Overseer, and proliferate effects (Tekuthal, Thrummingbird, Deepglow Skate), then win through Darksteel Reactor reaching 20 charge counters or overwhelming combat with large artifact creatures.

Sacrifice lands to Hearthhull and other outlets to draw cards and trigger landfall payoffs, winning through Omnath's burn damage, Moraug's extra combats, and Rampaging Baloths tokens, with incremental life drain from Hearthhull's trigger.

Attack with vampires to transform them into Demons via Clavileño, then sacrifice them to drain opponents through Blood Artist, Cruel Celebrant, and Falkenrath Noble. The commander's death triggers create 4/3 tokens for sustained sacrifice fodder and value.

Ramp into high-toughness Dinosaurs, chain discover triggers via Pantlaza to generate card advantage and cheat out threats, then win through combat damage with large creatures like Zacama, Zetalpa, and Etali.

Generate recurring lifegain by creating and sacrificing Food tokens via Sam, Loyal Attendant and other Food sources, triggering lifegain payoffs like Sanguine Bond to drain opponents and Well of Lost Dreams for card advantage, while Frodo rewards 3+ life gained per turn with card draw and Ring temptation.

Mill high-impact creatures into the graveyard via Sauron's cast trigger and self-mill spells like Faithless Looting and Forbidden Alchemy, then reanimate them with Living Death or Reanimate to overwhelm opponents with large threats like Inferno Titan and The Balrog of Moria.
Deploy a wide board of Elves, trigger Galadriel's will of the council ability for counters or card draw, then overwhelm opponents with combat damage via Overwhelming Stampede or Genesis Wave.

Draw cards through enchantress effects (Enchantress's Presence, Eidolon of Blossoms, Setessan Champion) and Ellivere's combat damage trigger, then win by attacking with creatures massively pumped by enchantment-scaling auras like Ancestral Mask and Ethereal Armor.

Assemble a full party (Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, Wizard) to trigger Nalia's combat ability, giving all creatures +1/+1 counters and deathtouch each turn. Win through combat damage with the boosted party members, with aristocrats drain effects as backup via Zulaport Cutthroat and Butcher of Malakir.

Attack with Dragons to trigger Firkraag's goad ability, forcing opponents' creatures to attack each other. When goaded creatures deal combat damage, Firkraag grows and draws cards. Win through commander damage or large Dragons like Drakuseth and Astral Dragon.
